senses.gloss: (cmp. גָּרַד), Pi. קֵירֵד to scrape; to curry (with a small-toothed strigil), v. קֵירוּד.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 2:8">Bets. II, 8</cite> <he>מְקָרְדִין את וכ׳</he> you may curry an animal on the Holy Day.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 2:8">Ib.</cite> <he>אין מקרדין … אבל מקרצפין</he> you must not curry … with small-toothed strigils …, but you may do so with large-toothed ones.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 938:32">Yalk. Deut. 938</cite> <he>מְקָרְדוֹ והוא בולם</he> (<cite ref="G00078"><he>את</he></cite>) thou curriest him, and he kicks, v. <cite ref="B00882"><he>בָּלַם</he> II</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 4:2:10">Y. Sabb. IV, end, 7ᵃ</cite> <he>שיקרדם</he>, v. <cite ref="S01920"><he>קִרְדֵּס</he></cite>.]
